items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: He was a professor in the Al Jays. Alphonse Cobet.

ctx.x: Were any of your family musicals?
Yes, my grandfather was an old time clarinet player. He was a professor in the Al Jays. Alphonse Cobet.
Did he teach clarinet only or teach other music?
